### Questions for you (2)

- [`recording-ready-window.ts:134`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-wachi-v3/blob/b2705a9ce2593b29ae50235312a4226955bbbb36/apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-ready-window.ts#L134) · trade-off — `show()` resolves true as soon as the window object exists. The alternative is to resolve only once the card reports ready, with a timeout, so the in-app card can take over. That is more machinery for a rare failure, and the toast window does not do it.
- [`use-floating-ready-card.ts:18`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-wachi-v3/blob/b2705a9ce2593b29ae50235312a4226955bbbb36/apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording-ready/use-floating-ready-card.ts#L18) · trade-off — Whether "once per arrival" should survive a remount of the detail page, as the doc and hook comment say. If it should, the guard has to move out of component state, for example into module scope or by clearing `fromRecording` from the history entry.

<details><summary>What the change connects to (6 closed, 0 open)</summary>

Questions the reviewer answered about what this change does to the running product. The engine checked that the cited lines exist, not that the answers are true.

**Closed, with the lines they rest on**

- Main window asks main to float the "Your video is ready" card (`recording-ready:show`, invoke) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-ready-window.ts:104`) — A frameless, always-on-top card appears at the top-right of the recorded display, inactive, on every Space. An invalid payload or failed window creation resolves false, which makes the page show the in-app card (`use-floating-ready-card.ts:26-28`). If it fails: Creation failure is caught and resolves false, which gives the in-app fallback. A load failure or a renderer that never reports ready resolves true, so the card never appears and there is no fallback… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-ready-window.ts:104-107`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-ready-window.ts:134-147`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-ready-window.ts:219-226`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/screenshots/capture-toast-window.ts:150-160`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording-ready/use-floating-ready-card.ts:26-28`.
- A card press hands off to the main window (`recording-ready:action` then `recording-ready:open`) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts:899`) — The card hides first (`close()` before `openInMain`), the main window comes forward and `AppRoot` navigates through `pathForHandOff`. If it fails: A press after the card is closed finds `payload === null` and does nothing. A ✕ or an unoffered Edit opens nothing. `showMainWindow` does not call `app.focus({ steal: true })` or re-apply the Dock po… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-ready-window.ts:166-172`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts:449-457`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts:145-150`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts:747-753`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts:683-707`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/types/recording-ready.ts:91-106`.
- Hub remembers the display of the latest take (`lastTakeDisplayId`) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:666`) — The card opens on the recorded display, or on the display under the pointer when that is unknown. If it fails: None found: NaN and empty ids are excluded by the `Number.isFinite` check and by `|| undefined`. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:662-666`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:707-714`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:934-941`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-ready-window.ts:237-244`.
- Ask main to float "Your video is ready" once per arrival on a fresh recording's page (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording-ready/use-floating-ready-card.ts:16`) — The card floats in its own window. The in-app card shows only as a fallback, never both (`showInAppCard = showCard && floatingCard.inApp`, library-detail-page.tsx:155). If it fails: A false answer or a rejection falls back to the in-app card (tested at library-detail-page.test.tsx:759-766). A stalled probe means no card (`probeSettled` never turns true, library-detail-page.tsx:1… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording-ready/use-floating-ready-card.ts:16-32`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:130-155`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-copy.ts:42-67`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/probe-source.ts:28-47`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-ready-window.ts:134-147`.
- Remount of the detail page under the same history entry (Back from Prepare or the editor) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:101`) — The floating card reappears after Back, even though the user already acted on it. If it fails: The card shows twice for one recording. Reported as a finding. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording-ready/use-floating-ready-card.ts:18-29`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:101`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/app-root.tsx:75`.
- Open the card's window at ?window=recording-ready, and hand its actions off to the main window (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/main.tsx:66`) — A transparent window shows the card inset 16px. Chips, Edit first and Open reach `navigate(pathForHandOff(...))` in the main window (use-recording-ready-hand-offs.ts:31); Dismiss only closes it. If it fails: If the card renderer throws, `installCrashForwarder('recording-ready')` forwards it; main accepts the origin as a free string. The hand-off sent to the main window's renderer is the part-1 window man… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/main.tsx:66-71`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording-ready/recording-ready-card.tsx:24-53`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording-ready/use-recording-ready-hand-offs.ts:13-34`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/analytics/crash-forwarder.ts:8-19`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/assets/main.css:85-93`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/status-card.module.css:2-13`.

</details>

<details><summary>What the reviewer checked</summary>

**Batch 1 of 2.** Part 1 adds a floating \"Your video is ready\" window modelled on the capture toast. The card's own channels check the sender, and the hand-off is derived in main from the stored payload. `shared/types/recording-ready.ts` is pure, with no value import from a workspace package. I found no blocker. I raise two \"consider\" items on the main side. First, `show()` resolves true before the card renderer has loaded, so a failed load loses the card with no in-app fallback. Second, `recording-ready:show` does not check its sender. I also note a bare `satisfies` expression statement in `post-recording-card.tsx` that the repo's oxlint config may warn about.","risk_facts":[{"kind":"public-contract","path":"apps/kaipu-record/src/preload/index.ts","line":244,"why":"Adds `showRecordingReady`, `recordingReadyCard` and `onRecordingReadyOpen` to the `contextBridge` API, which every window that loads the shared preload can call."}]

**Batch 2 of 2.** The renderer half of the floating card is sound. The window root, the hand-off hook, the fallback logic and the CSS all match the capture-toast pattern, and I found nothing that blocks the merge. Three notes. The card can float a second time when the detail page remounts under the same history entry, for example on Back from Prepare. The card now waits on the source probe, which has no timeout. One new test duplicates two existing ones, and the probe-error path is untested. The doc and the i18n strings are consistent with the code. I did not run any tests.
